title: aggregation.current_usage_in_advance
description: Current-usage units and billable aggregation of a pay-in-advance sum charge (BE-AG-44): the period total versus the cached running state.

total.description: Sum of the period's event values.

window.description: Charges window of the billing period (BE-AG-7): both bounds inclusive.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (floored to the millisecond by the store).

charges_duration_days.description: Days of the full (unclipped) charges period; divisor of every proration and of weighted sums.
charges_duration_days.x-kit-absent: the number of calendar days from the date of `from` to the date of `to`, inclusive, in UTC

timezone.description: Customer's applicable time zone (local dates for proration).
